structured_output.content: The `UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer` feature is promoted from beta to GA in cert-manager v1.18.0, and this environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate resources actively used. GA promotion means the feature becomes enabled by default and may alter resource finalizer behavior. Review the upgrade notes to determine what this finalizer does, check if your Certificates or other resources rely on current finalizer behavior, and confirm whether any configuration or manual steps are needed before upgrading.
